tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The whole screen rests here; sections separate by space and by `line`, not by boxes.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Repository rail and recessed areas (composer field, code blocks). Deeper than `paper`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Actionable items (focused task rows, "Precisa de você" cards) and the side panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Overlapping layers: open composer, menus, floating side panel on medium screens.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px divider hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control border (fields, secondary buttons, checkbox). ≥3:1 over `paper`, `paper-sunk`, `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and task titles over any background (`paper`, `paper-sunk`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and the `*-wash` tones).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: reasons, metadata, captions. ≥4.5:1 over all backgrounds and washes in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary: timestamps, PR numbers in dense lists. Still ≥4.5:1 over all backgrounds — nothing essential falls below that.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: The agent's voice: running task, current step, "live" dot. Text and marks over all backgrounds and `agent-wash`.

tokens.name: agent-wash
tokens.usage: Soft background of the "Agora" strip and of agent messages in the panel.

tokens.name: on-agent
tokens.usage: Text over `agent` fill.

tokens.name: you
tokens.usage: What is yours: items waiting for you, the "since your visit" row, selection, primary action, links. Text over all backgrounds and `you-wash`.

tokens.name: you-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the selected row and of your messages in the panel.

tokens.name: on-you
tokens.usage: Text over `you` fill (primary button).

tokens.name: halt
tokens.usage: Blocked, failed, red CI. Always with a word and a square glyph — never color alone. Text over all backgrounds and `halt-wash`.

tokens.name: halt-wash
tokens.usage: Background of block notices and of failed CI after the merge.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Stale or late data: delayed sync, frozen clocks. Text over all backgrounds and `stale-wash`.

tokens.name: stale-wash
tokens.usage: Strip "mostrando dados de HH:MM" when the connection drops.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px from the element. ≥3:1 over all backgrounds in both themes.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Repository name at the top. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section header and title in the side panel.

styles.name: task
styles.usage: Task or PR title in lists.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The seed tests pass; the spawn still needs reviewing at the edges.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control labels and section counts. In normal case — no spaced capitals.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Times, durations, tokens, hashes, agent commands. Always with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a status glyph and the word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and kbd.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between elements in a task row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a task row; button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its content; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between main sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Breathing room above the empty state.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, tags, kbd.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Focused task rows and "Precisa de você" cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Side panel, composer, "Agora" strip.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Sync dot, filters, voice indicator.

tokens.name: shadow-layer
tokens.usage: Only for what floats over the content: composer, panel in overlay mode, menus.
